ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, and the horizontal line segment LK passes through the solid point at the center of the circle, so LK is a diameter. Point L is at the left end of the circle, point K is at the right end of the circle, and point J is on the circumference at the lower right of the circle. Line segments KJ and KL form an inscribed angle marked 62° at point K. The problem asks for the measure of minor arc JK. Reasoning: The inscribed angle ∠LKJ intercepts arc LJ, so according to the inscribed angle theorem, m arc LJ = 2 × 62° = 124°. Since LK is a diameter, the measure of the arc from L to K through the lower semicircle is 180°. This lower semicircle is composed of arc LJ and arc JK, therefore m arc JK = 180° - 124° = 56°.

method.CoT_raw:

推理：圆周角 ∠LKJ 截得的是弧 LJ，所以根据圆周角定理，m弧 LJ = 2 × 62° = 124°。由于 LK 是直径，经过下半圆从 L 到 K 的弧度数为 180°。这个下半圆由弧 LJ 和弧 JK 组成，因此 m弧 JK = 180° - 124° = 56°。
